page.heading: New circuit
page.intro: Drag a gate onto the grid, or press its key and then Enter on a cell.

canvas.label: Quantum circuit diagram
canvas.contents: Circuit contents, wire by wire and moment by moment.
canvas.readOnly: Read-only on small screens. Scroll to explore the circuit.
canvas.tooManyColumns: This circuit reaches column {{total}}, and the canvas draws the first {{drawn}}. The {{hidden}} columns past that are in the document and in the simulation, but not in the drawing.

presets.heading: Examples
presets.hint: Each one replaces the circuit below.

superposition.name: Superposition
superposition.summary: Two wires in superposition: four outcomes, all equally likely.

bell.summary: Two qubits entangled. Neither has a state of its own any more — only the pair does.

ghz.summary: The same entanglement across three qubits: all zeros or all ones, never anything in between.

interference.name: Interference
interference.summary: One qubit, two paths. The phase decides whether they add up or cancel out.

deutschJozsa.summary: One run answers a question a classical procedure needs two evaluations for.

teleportation.name: Teleportation
teleportation.summary: A state moves to another qubit, carried by entanglement and two classical bits.

share.heading: Share
share.hint: The whole circuit travels inside the link. Nothing is stored on a server.
share.failed: The link could not be copied. Select the field and copy it yourself.
share.tooLarge: This circuit is too large to fit in a link.

rejected.too-long: The circuit in that link is longer than this editor will read.
rejected.not-base64: That link was damaged on the way here: part of it is missing or was rewritten.
rejected.not-deflate: That link is damaged and could not be unpacked.
rejected.too-large: The circuit in that link is far larger than this editor can open.
rejected.not-json: That link unpacked to something that is not a circuit.
rejected.not-a-circuit: The circuit in that link does not match the format this editor understands.

placement.pickTarget: needs another target qubit in this column. Move the cursor and press Enter.
placement.pickControl: needs its control qubit in this column. Move the cursor and press Enter.
placement.no-gate-armed: Choose a gate first, then press Enter on a cell.
placement.other-column: The rest of the gate has to go in the same column.
placement.qubit-already-used: This gate already uses that qubit.
placement.not-enough-qubits: That gate needs more wires than the circuit has. Add a qubit first.
placement.classical-row: The classical register is read-only. A measurement reaches it from its own qubit.
placement.nothing-here: There is nothing here to delete.
placement.read-only: The editor is read-only on small screens.
placement.cancelled-by-register-edit: The half-placed gate was cancelled: the wire it was on has changed.
placement.no-free-clbit: Every classical bit is already written in that column. Add one to the classical register, or use another column.

feedback.noGaps: There were no gaps to close.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.none: Select a parametrised gate to change its angles.

timeline.heading: Timeline
timeline.hint: The bar holds the circuit at one instant, and the panel below describes the state there. The arrow keys step one column, Home and End jump to either end, and Space plays.

dnd.instructions: Press Space to pick the gate up, the arrow keys to move it one cell at a time, Space again to drop it, and Escape to cancel.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.note: The whole editor works without a pointer.
shortcuts.move: Move the cursor across the grid
shortcuts.rowEnds: Jump to the first or last column of the wire
shortcuts.arm: Choose a gate from the palette
shortcuts.place: Place the chosen gate, or select the one under the cursor
shortcuts.pickUp: Pick a gate up and drag it with the arrow keys
shortcuts.cancel: Cancel a half-placed gate, put the chosen gate down, or clear the selection
shortcuts.remove: Delete the gate under the cursor
shortcuts.timelineStep: Move the timeline bar one column, or to either end
shortcuts.timelinePlay: Play or pause the timeline, with the bar focused

rejection.shape: That file does not match the circuit format.
rejection.unknown-gate: That gate is not in the catalog.
rejection.arity-mismatch: That gate acts on a different number of qubits.
rejection.control-count-mismatch: That gate does not take this many controls.
rejection.param-count-mismatch: That gate takes a different number of parameters.
rejection.clbit-target-mismatch: That gate writes to a different number of classical bits.
rejection.qubit-out-of-range: That qubit is outside the circuit.
rejection.clbit-out-of-range: That classical bit is outside the circuit. Add one to the classical register.
rejection.target-control-overlap: A gate cannot be controlled by a qubit it acts on.
rejection.repeated-qubit: A gate cannot use the same qubit twice.
rejection.column-conflict: Another gate already occupies that cell.
rejection.unknown-parameter: That parameter is not declared in the circuit.
rejection.duplicate-operation-id: Two operations share the same identifier.
rejection.duplicate-parameter: That parameter is declared more than once.
rejection.qubit-label-count: The circuit needs one name per qubit.
rejection.custom-gate-cycle: A custom gate cannot contain itself.
rejection.operation-not-found: That gate is no longer in the circuit.
rejection.control-not-found: That gate has no control on this qubit.
rejection.empty-selection: Select at least one gate first.
rejection.register-limit: The circuit has reached its limit of qubits or classical bits.
rejection.nothing-to-undo: There is nothing left to undo.
rejection.nothing-to-redo: There is nothing left to redo.
rejection.clbit-in-use: Another operation in that column already writes to that classical bit.
rejection.custom-gate-too-deep: Those blocks are nested too deeply inside one another.
rejection.custom-gate-not-unitary: A block cannot contain a measurement, a reset or a conditioned gate.
rejection.custom-gate-too-large: Those blocks expand to more operations than a circuit may hold.
rejection.custom-gate-name: A block needs a name that starts with a letter and is not already a gate.
rejection.custom-gate-exists: This circuit already has a block with that name.
rejection.custom-gate-not-found: This circuit has no block with that name.
rejection.custom-gate-in-use: That block is still used in this circuit. Expand its uses first.
rejection.custom-gate-reshaped: That change alters the wires or the parameters the existing uses were placed with.
rejection.fragment-not-rectangular: The selection skips a gate between its first and last column. Select the whole range.
rejection.not-a-custom-gate: That gate is not a block, so there is nothing to expand.
rejection.definition-open: A block is already open for editing.
rejection.no-definition-open: No block is open for editing.

customGates.title: Blocks
customGates.summary: Package a fragment as a reusable block with a name and an icon.
customGates.empty: No blocks yet. Select a run of gates on the canvas and package it.

package.heading: Package the selection
package.name: Name
package.hint: The selection must cover every gate between its first and last column.

shared.heading: One definition, every use
shared.body_one: Editing this definition changes its {{value}} use in this circuit. There is no way to change only one of them.
shared.body_other: Editing this definition changes all {{value}} uses in this circuit. There is no way to change only one of them.
shared.unused: Nothing uses this definition yet, so editing it changes nothing else.
shared.escape: Duplicate it first if you want to change one use and leave the rest alone.

editing.heading: Editing the block {{name}}
editing.note: This canvas is the block’s own body. Its wires are the block’s wires, and its parameters are the angles a use supplies.

done.packaged: Packaged the selection as the block {{name}}.
done.placed: Placed the block {{name}} on the canvas.
done.opened: Editing the block {{name}}. The canvas now shows its body instead of the circuit.
done.applied: Applied the changes to {{name}} to every use of it.
done.discarded: Discarded the changes to {{name}}. The circuit is back.
done.inlined: Expanded one use of {{name}} into the gates it stands for.
